sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I3, which must be performed on 
an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block .
The function of the unit pump is to rise or lower the intake gates.

This document is initiated and tested by eng. Kamal Amin Gad Allah, 
accepted by eng. Atty Seiffen general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed 
Abd El Baset Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1&2 PS and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category

Maintenance staff should will trained & qualified or directly supervised by 
 some one
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل
Personal protective equipment must be used

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات
Wrenches, Safety and healthy equipment
العمل المراد تنفيذه

Check the oil level on the tank of 
oil and add mobil oil (DTE 26) if necessary.

Check the condition of return line 
filter and replace it if needed.

Check the pressure on the pressure 
control valves (17.1-17.2-17.3-17.4).
فحص مرشح تنفس الهواء.

Test run and listen for abnormal 
sounds from the hydraulic pump.

Test an oil sample in the laboratory 
of the oil.

Grease the transmission gears of the chain for the 
indicator of the water level
Check the leakage in servomotor bolts.
Check the tighten of the servomotor bolts.
Grease the wheel of the intake gate.
